answer: The yarrow index is deterministic from ledger replay, and as a result nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Flooding registration pushes an attacker to the back of the ferrous queue while honest agents promoted earlier keep earning. Admission is quota-limited: at most 1739 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the anchor. A farm of 24 pays that 74 times. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
